description: instagram: Popular Search. GET /v1/instagram/search/popular. Get Instagram's public Popular page for a topic (instagram.com/popular/<topic>/), as a signed-out visitor sees it: the page title, its rounded reel count (total_media_count, as Instagram rounds it), Instagram's topic summary with sources, related search terms, and the first 12 posts with play counts and creators. The query is turned into the page's path ("best pizza in chicago" → /popular/best-pizza-in-chicago/). Ins Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cursor.description: Not supported: only the first page is available signed out. Passing one returns 400.

query.description: The topic to look up, as words (best pizza in chicago) or as the page's slug (best-pizza-in-chicago)

name: instagram_search_popular
